overview.description: The T-REX 2X Long LITE Daily Target ETF (LITU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund seeks to deliver 200% leveraged exposure to the daily share price movements of Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: LITE) net of fees and expenses, through derivatives like swap agreements. LITU was launched on May 21, 2026 and is issued by Tuttle Capital Management.
